parameters.incompatibleCornerPolicy: disable corner correction when any RGB spread exceeds 48; do not conceal material/geometry discrepancy
parameters.boundaryExtension: clamp field to core boundary through 115px halo
parameters.smoothSurfaceSamplingPolicy: Geometry-reviewed inputs; every seam uses smooth same-coordinate pixel samples only; RGB gradient<6 and difference<65, at least8/40 samples per profile row
parameters.geometrySafety: No color correction used to conceal geometry; all 24 seams and 9 crossings inspected; geometry reviewed; color and texture acceptance remains pending native visual review

algorithm: robust paired overlap half-difference; 24px profile smoothing; shared four-source corner target when feasible, otherwise zero corner correction pending source review; bounded harmonic correction-field extension within 384px; no source pixel interpolation
